sources.name: DrivenData GEMS problem description
sources.verified_takeaway: Task is fault prediction; known fault data may be incomplete or inaccurate; the metric is distance-weighted Tversky. The description does not disclose hidden fault coordinates or a causal score explanation.

sources.verified_takeaway: On 2026-10-07 the rendered table showed xiaofanhu at 0.3774 and participant extradr19 at rank 13 with 0.2778. The page exposes no file name or hash for the score, and participant identity is not authenticated to this repository.

sources.name: DOE/NLR official competition rules
sources.verified_takeaway: Up to three public automated-score submissions per week are permitted by the competition website; one final submission is selected for both prize rounds. The single GeoTIFF output, participant responsibility, and generative-AI disclosure requirement are recorded in the session notes.
sources.retrieval_note: PDF content was retrieved through the Arena web fetch; direct sandbox TLS retrieval failed during the separate source refresh.

sources.name: USGS OFR 00-189: Summary of geophysical investigations of the Death Valley regional water-flow modeling project
sources.source_class: U.S. Geological Survey primary technical report
sources.verified_takeaway: Report describes gravity anomalies arising from density contrasts, magnetic anomalies from subsurface magnetic rocks, and faults offsetting magnetic lithologies as a possible magnetic expression. It also describes alternate fluvial interpretations for subtle anomalies.
sources.scope_limit: Regional Death Valley/Amargosa study; not a validation of every Great Basin grid cell, the H55 transform, or a score gain.

sources.name: USGS OFR 00-188: Aeromagnetic survey of the Amargosa Desert, Nevada and California
sources.source_class: U.S. Geological Survey primary technical report
sources.verified_takeaway: Report describes some linear magnetic anomalies associated with shallow faults and subtle anomalies over alluvium. It explicitly notes competing explanations including fault-zone alteration and fluvial concentration/reworking of magnetic minerals.
sources.scope_limit: Regional survey report; not a universal magnetic-fault rule or a validation of H55 predictions.

sources.name: INGENIOUS — Great Basin Regional Dataset Compilation (GDR submission 1391)
sources.verified_takeaway: Public record advertises well/spring temperature and chemistry data and paleo-geothermal feature data with a CC BY 4.0 license. These are considered only in preregistered H55-2, not in any feature/model/output.
sources.access_status: Official metadata page fetched; the linked 19.85 MB well/spring archive failed direct TLS with SSL_ERROR_SYSCALL and the paleo-geothermal ZIP returned HTTP 500. Raw files were not obtained or used.

sources.name: Blum and Mitchell (1998), Combining labeled and unlabeled data with co-training
sources.verified_takeaway: Co-training theory relies on view sufficiency and an approximate conditional-independence premise; the measured blockwise correlation is a diagnostic, not a proof that the premise holds.
